name: jamie
insight: Founded in Berlin in 2022; processes data only on EU servers in Frankfurt and is ISO 27001 certified.
tagline: Bot-free AI note taker for any meeting — online, hybrid, or in person.
description: jamie is an AI meeting assistant that writes structured summaries, action items, and transcripts without ever joining the call as a bot. Instead of adding a participant, its desktop and iPhone apps capture audio directly from the device, so it works on any platform — Zoom, Meet, Teams — and in face-to-face conversations. After the meeting it assigns accurate speaker names and lets you query the notes with an Ask-AI feature.
edge: Captures meetings without sending a bot into the call, so it works on any platform and in person — then assigns speaker names after the meeting.
pros: Works online, hybrid, and in person

references.title: This AI meeting assistant is the first one I've tried that isn't annoying
